author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a hand home on G, walk and run-ning notes, open and closed endings, zigzag steps, counting threes and two-hand teamwork.

classes.title: Thumb on G, ready to bow
classes.goal: Find the hand home on G, by the three black keys, and play the first line slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the group of three black keys to place the hand

classes.parentPrompt: Touch the three black keys together; help your child rest the thumb on G, after the first.
classes.childAction: Thumb on G, then one finger on each key up to D.
classes.bridge: G sits just after the first of three black keys; the hand fills G to D.

intro.caption: Ready to bow
intro.parentCue: Touch three black keys, then find G together

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers together, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: placing the hand with the three black keys.

classes.title: Walk and run-ning dance
classes.goal: Play the first line, feeling walking notes and run-ning notes twice as fast.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two quick run-ning notes fit in the time of one walk

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'walk' on the long notes and 'run-ning' on each quick pair as your child plays.
classes.childAction: Walk on D, run up from G, then two bows on G.
classes.bridge: Walking notes are slow dance steps; run-ning notes are quick tiptoes up the keys.

games.caption: Walk, run-ning, run-ning, walk
games.parentCue: Say the words slowly with each note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: walk and run-ning notes, two to one.

classes.title: Rest on A, home on G
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and compare its two endings.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first ending pauses on A; the second ends home on G

classes.parentPrompt: Shrug at the first ending on A; nod and bow at the second ending on G.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; shrug when it rests on A, bow when it lands on G.
classes.bridge: The first ending tiptoes past black F sharp and waits on A; the second goes home.

intro.caption: Rest on A, home on G
intro.parentCue: Shrug on the first ending, bow on the second

games.caption: Wait on A... home on G

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing an open ending and a closed one.

classes.title: Round and round the hall
classes.goal: Practise the zigzag 'little steps' line slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: Stepping up and down around a note, like circling

classes.parentPrompt: Draw little circles in the air as your child plays; say the finger numbers aloud.
classes.bridge: The dancers circle the hall: a step up, a step back, then down.

intro.caption: Watch slowly
intro.parentCue: Say the finger numbers aloud together

games.caption: Little steps, round and round
games.parentCue: Draw little circles in the air with each note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: zigzag steps with careful fingers.

classes.title: Low G, the deep bow
classes.goal: Play one low left hand note at the start of each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar has three beats; the left hand plays on one

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; count one-two-three each bar, loud on one, for your child's low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays the low note on every one.
classes.bridge: Low G is G in a lower house: the same name, a deeper bow.

intro.caption: Low G, the deep bow
intro.parentCue: count to three, loud on one

games.caption: One two three, one two three
games.parentCue: Say one loud with each low note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting three beats and playing on one.

classes.title: Two dance partners
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note lasts while three beats go by above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'bow' on each low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand bows and holds; right hand dances the tune.
classes.bridge: Two dance partners: left hand bows low, right hand steps and twirls.

intro.caption: Two dance partners
intro.parentCue: Say 'bow' softly on each low note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two jobs at once.

classes.title: Dance in the big hall
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part in step while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and nod on every one; cheer for keeping going, not for notes.
classes.childAction: Dance along with the music. If a note slips, keep stepping!
classes.bridge: Partners keep dancing even if a step slips; the music carries you on.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping your part in step with the music.

classes.title: A graceful concert
classes.goal: Play the whole minuet smoothly for teddy, then bow like a dancer.

mathTarget.parentLine: Choosing a gentle, smooth sound to match a slow dance

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; after the last G, bow slowly together like dancers.
classes.childAction: Play smoothly for teddy, land home on G, then bow.
classes.bridge: Smooth fingers glide like dancers' feet; the last G is the final bow.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Seat teddy and announce the dance together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song smoothly, start to end.
